subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Explain what virtual reality is and how it is used
Talk about the uses and limits of virtual reality

tf.s: Virtual reality is an interactive environment made using a computer.
tf.why: Yes! You can interact with a computer world.

tf.s: Virtual reality can be used to train pilots and doctors.
tf.why: Right! It copies the real world for training.

tf.s: PacMan and Super Mario Brothers are early fictional virtual reality games.
Virtual reality today seems completely real.
tf.why: It is still difficult to make it seem real.

tf.s: Virtual reality of the future may include smell and touch.
tf.why: Yes! Not just sights and sounds.

tf.s: CAD software helps designers clearly see what they are trying to make.
tf.why: Good! CAD is used in design.

tf.s: 'Do you know when did it begin?' has the correct word order.
tf.why: The correct order is 'Do you know when it began?'

tf.s: Indirect questions are more polite than direct questions.
tf.why: Yes! 'Can you tell us…?' sounds polite.

tf.s: Reading the questions before you listen is a good listening strategy.
tf.why: Right! You know what to listen for.

tf.s: Virtual reality is mainly an experience of smell and taste.
tf.why: It is mainly a sound and sight (visual) experience.

o: an interactive environment made using a computer

boxes.q: Which is an example of virtual reality copying the real world?
What may future virtual reality add?
Why is virtual reality not yet fully real?
o: computers and the Internet are not powerful enough yet
Can you tell us what virtual reality is?
Can you tell us what is virtual reality?
boxes.why: In indirect questions, the verb comes after the subject.

o: Do you know when it began?
Do you know when did it begin?
Do you know when began it?

boxes.q: Turn into an indirect question: 'Where is the museum?'
o: Could you tell me where the museum is?
Could you tell me where is the museum?
Could you tell me the museum where?

boxes.q: What does CAD software help designers do?
o: see clearly what they are making

boxes.q: Virtual reality is mainly a sound and ___ experience.

hunt.q: A problem or limit of VR

mcq.q: What limitation does virtual reality have?
o: It is difficult to make it seem real
It cannot be used for games
mcq.why: Computers are not powerful enough yet.

mcq.q: Which games are early fictional virtual reality games?
Which is an indirect question phrase?
What do we usually use to control a computer in the text?
mcq.why: Keyboards and mice let us interact with computers.

mcq.q: Change into an indirect question: 'When did virtual reality begin?'
o: Do you know when virtual reality began?
Do you know when did virtual reality begin?
Do you know when virtual reality did begin?
Do you know virtual reality began when?
mcq.why: Drop 'did' and use the past form 'began'.

mcq.q: Which is a good indirect question about the future of virtual reality?
o: Do you have any idea what virtual reality will be like in the future?
What will be virtual reality like in the future?
Do you have any idea what will be virtual reality like?
mcq.why: Keep subject + verb order in indirect questions.

mcq.q: A hospital wants doctors to practise without danger to patients. How can virtual reality help?
o: by training doctors in a copy of the real world
mcq.why: VR can copy the real world for training.

mcq.q: Why does the writer think virtual reality will seem more real in future?
o: Computers and the Internet will develop
mcq.why: Better technology will make VR more real.

mcq.q: Why is CAD software useful for designers?
o: They can clearly see what they are trying to make
mcq.why: Seeing a design helps before building it.

mcq.q: Why do we change 'What is virtual reality?' into 'Can you tell us what virtual reality is?' when talking to an expert?
